rules.content:
title: Mass-Marketing Fraud Burst Calling Pattern
status: experimental
logsource:
    product: telecom
    service: cdr
detection:
    selection:
        call_direction: inbound
        call_duration|lt: 30
    timeframe: 1h
    condition: selection | count(distinct destination_number) by source_number_prefix > 50
fields:
    - source_number
    - destination_number
    - call_duration
    - caller_id_verification_status
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0134: Mass-Marketing Fraud Burst Calling Pattern — SIM Farm and Robodialling Detection (SIGMA)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Cialdini Persuasion Scoring")`
`comment("Requires NLP scoring service via DSDL or API")`
index=communications sourcetype=fraud:communications
| apply cialdini_scoring_model
| where cialdini_principles_detected >= 3
| where max_principle_score > 0.7
| table _time, channel, sender, recipient,
        reciprocity_score, consistency_score, social_proof_score,
        authority_score, liking_score, scarcity_score,
        cialdini_principles_detected
rules.title: DL-0140: Cialdini Persuasion Principle Scoring in Fraud Communications (SPLUNK)
